method.summary: Re-ran all 6 adjudicated scored cells + family verdicts from a detached twin at the frozen output commit 25a781d using the committed E-lane driver and the frozen implementation (research/assets/forex_ng1/run/*, read-only); compared every output artifact recursively against the committed artifacts in the twin tree (which are sha-identical 8/8 to the integration worktree's committed e/ directory).
method.driver_fidelity: committed e/run_scored.py copied byte-for-byte and patched at EXACTLY 4 plumbing points (diff verified 4 hunks, no other byte changed): REPO_ROOT -> twin root; CONTROL_DIR -> twin control dir; E_DIR -> /tmp reproduction out dir; DISPATCH_SHA -> 25a781d (the reproduction base check). All computation logic (books, kernel reconciliation, evaluator, verdicts, artifact writers) untouched.
method.data_pins: identical absolute paths as the contract: DGS10 pinned copy (.worktrees/forex-ng1/integration/.worktrees/forex-ng1/i-runners/data_raw/forex_ng1_ctl/DGS10.json, sha-pinned 03dde429, verified in-run), spot pin manifest copy_path fallback (.worktrees/forex-ng1/p1-spot/data_raw/forex_ng1_spot, sha-verified on read), CADS store (.runtime/v3_cads_store, S2 manifest 07d1e0d5... resolve-verify), vintaged CPI legs (.worktrees/forex-free-v9/integration/data_raw/forex_free_v9_cpi), census + proposals + selection_freeze + run_contract read from the twin tree (sha-pinned, verified in-run); grid recompute 1842 days verified in-run.
method.comparison_rules: byte compare (sha256) then recursive field compare with type checks; a diff is ENV_ONLY only if it is (a) run-context fields (timestamps, runtime, lock registry fields, run_head_sha/run_branch, output paths), or (b) a mechanical derivative of (a) proven by verifications V1-V3; any other diff would be SCIENTIFIC and force MISMATCH. No tolerance was widened or applied; numeric equality is exact.
method.environment: python 3.12.14 (repo root .venv), macOS arm64; scratch /tmp/forex_ng1_e_scored_scratch (frozen loader rewrites US-leg materialization each run)
method.out_of_scope: non-scored artifacts (dryrun, d1/d2, p0/p1) not recomputed; per-period series are embedded in the cell artifacts (no separate series files exist) and were compared recursively as part of the cells.
